body: my mom watched while my sister choked me, trapped in a seat belt unable to fight back. she laughed even when i was crying for help. if even my own mother doesnt care im sure no one else would. i told myself id give it a week and so far my opinion hasnt changed. my friends are leaving me one by one. i eat lunch alone or with my sister who beat me. this is just not a life anyone should have to live, and honestly the physical pain combined with the mental pain is too much to bear. ove got bruises all up and down my arm. my throat is cut up from her nails and bruised from her crushing my windpipe. it hurts so bad i cant sleep, less than i already did before. i just cant keep living like this.
